title: Affiliate Networks Explained: The Honest Guide to Choosing One (and Not Getting Burned)
summary: What an affiliate network actually does, how Amazon, CJ, Awin, Impact and TikTok Shop compare, and the cap and attribution questions to ask before you sign up.
body_markdown:
## For Brands: Building a Creator-Led Affiliate Program Instead of Only Joining Someone Else's


[TikTok Shop](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/what-ai-creator-search-tool-should-you-use-for-managing-tiktok-shop-affiliates-across-multiple-client-brands) brands can build direct creator partnerships rather than rely only on publisher access through a network. Networks offer existing structures; in-house programs give teams more control over creator selection, offers, and relationships. Decide based on the capacity you can commit to recruitment, fulfillment, and measurement.


### When to Run In-House vs. Join a Network: A Decision Framework for DTC Sellers


Run an in-house program if you need direct creator relationships and can manage outreach, samples, commissions, and reporting. A network suits teams seeking an existing publisher base and ready-made structure. Compare who handles recruitment, controls terms, provides performance data, and owns ongoing operations.


### Recruiting at Scale Without Reply-Rate Collapse: Automated, Personalized Outreach


A larger prospect list without relevant outreach can bring more silence, not more useful partnerships. Set creator criteria and tailor invitations to content, product fit, selling points, and offer. Reacher ranks more than 4 million TikTok Shop creators from a brand description, transcript, product image, or lookalike. Outreach supports DM, Target Collab, and email at up to 10,000 creators a day, with personalized drafts, tone controls, and message previews before sending.


### Contracts, Samples, and Per-Creator GMV: The Operational Layer Ranked Pages Skip


After recruitment, teams need to track conversations, samples, creator status, and sales with partnership context intact. Reacher’s[creator CRM](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/creator-crm) brings those details together; sample requests run through one queue with bulk rejection and weekly caps. Campaign Contracts sends DocuSign agreements inside Community Campaigns using Reacher’s standard template in V1. Per-creator GMV reporting helps assess activity beyond application and posting counts.


### Measuring Cross-Channel Impact: Connecting TikTok Content to Sales Off-Platform


A TikTok post may influence a later purchase on another channel.[Halo Effect](https://www.reacherapp.com/features/halo-effect) connects TikTok content to Amazon, Shopify, and retail sales and calculates cross-channel ROAS. Use it alongside creator-level reporting to see where sales appear, while recognizing that connected reporting does not prove every sale came from a particular post.


#### Pros


- Direct relationships and clearer control over creator offers.
- Connected workflows for outreach, samples, and performance review.


#### Cons


- Your team must own recruitment and ongoing program operations.
- Cross-channel reporting does not establish causation for each sale.

Review its terms for fit with your audience and promotion plan.
